metadata.description: The AURORA Agent (bioprism) plugin marketplace. Install aurora-agent for the full backend — the FIBER decision-context compiler, 259 MCP tools, missions, and operations evidence — plus optional discipline and workspace skill packs.

plugins.name: aurora-agent
plugins.description: THE plugin: bioprism MCP server (262 tools), FIBER compile/explain/compare/validate/verify commands, mission preflight, ops-auditor subagent, and setup/workflow/SDK skills. Requires a built aurora-agent checkout.

plugins.name: aurora-honesty
plugins.description: Optional: the honest-labelling discipline for any codebase (honest-labelling creed, keep-a-claim-honest, prove-a-scanner-fires, windows-test-truth).

plugins.name: aurora-workspace
plugins.description: Optional: engineering skills for working inside the aurora-agent repo itself (add-module, check-parity, verify-crate, classify-blueprint-modules, measure-section-boilerplate).
